text: The Qur'an is for all people. Encourage your child: “Pick a verse, understand its meaning from a reliable tafsir, and live by it for a week.” The Qur'an is memorised, understood and lived.

review_defects.why: Arabic addresses a son specifically; English broadens to any child.
The Arabic specifies 'your son' (ابنك) but the English generalises to 'your child'.
